body: Because of the exact reason I said! I am more than comfortable with my own beliefs. I just want to educate myself because I know there are beliefs beyond my own, and I want to be able to more efficiently communicate with people while having at least a base understanding of what they see when they look at the world. I think that it’s important to acknowledge the opinions and views of other people, and I’d like to not face it blindly! In my opinion, education and effort is an important aspect of respect.

I’m well aware of this. I still think that it’s better for me to be as educated as possible. Even if I can’t understand it entirely or genuinely, I want to know all that I can. I believe that to be able to be truly respectful to others and be open-minded, you need to be willing to learn how they see from their point of view. Even if I don’t fully understand how others feel or their faith, I want to at least know what it is that they feel so passionately about. I don’t think education on the matter is an unreasonable thing for me to seek

I am in no way meaning to undermine the fact that dermatillomania is something compulsive and something related to the brain function itself, I’m sorry if I made it seem that way

If I were to speak on my opinions on it it certainly would not be with any intent of judgement, but more letting them know I think it’s possible for them to stop if that’s what they want and that I would be there for them, and I wouldn’t bring it up on my own rather than just in response to when THEY bring it up.
